questions.prompt: The European Data Protection Board mandated that the enterprise cloud provider _____ all transatlantic telemetry transfers pending adequacy review.

explanations.correct: C2 cloud litigation & cyber governance discourse: Mandative subjunctive requires base form 'suspend' after 'mandated that'.
explanations.wrong_A: Option 'suspends' violates formal mandative subjunctive or inversion rules.
explanations.wrong_C: Option 'shall suspend' applies inappropriate indicative or non-inverted syntax in formal legal IT discourse.
explanations.wrong_D: Option 'must to suspend' is completely non-standard in international cyber jurisprudence.
